comparison.objective: Cut copper tubing at a mark with a screw-feed tubing cutter without denting it.

comparison.success_condition: Credit tracks groove/cut progress and location, with permanent zero for excessive bite or measurable tube denting, plus final gripper clearance; candidate tracks recovered media and retained washers.
comparison.reason: Controlled rotary cutting is meaningfully unrelated to media screening. No material rubric detail is missing.
